comments.body: First year on ETH I got exactly 4.0. And trust me, that is not a catastrophe, afterwards every semester I got notes that gave in average 4,9-5,3. It's perfectly doable. To add to this point - you will underperform during the first year, since the difference between Hochschule and Gimnazjum is substantial and not many achieve the necessary shift in attitude to maintain the same level in terms of grades as in Gimnazjum. And also, you are now an adult. You have more duties and obligations to fulfill. This also complicates the comparison and any attempts to predict future
comments.author: Alex51423
